public_rationale: This is a claim about motive. It says the two labs did not pursue DeepSeek-style efficiency because their money and GPU access meant they never had to. The speaker himself grants that both firms had efficiency teams and that OpenAI tried a more efficient model in 2023. So the claim is about the degree and cause of their effort, not about whether any efficiency work happened. Counting a delivered gain, such as OpenAI's cheaper GPT-4o mini, as disproof would read 'it' against its context. Proving the motive would need internal evidence about why the companies chose their strategies, and none is public. With no plain, testable reading of either the effort or the cause, the claim cannot be fairly scored.
limitations: A narrower reading, such as 'they released no model rivalling V3 on price and performance', could be tested. But the speaker did not state it.
